items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: “I could play like Art Tatum, man, I had that accident.

ctx.x: Oh the man, oh just — he was one of the most, he was one of the kindest most gentle spirit. He was like a kid in a lot of ways. And you know we’d listen to music. I remember this one day he got out you know like four or five CDs from different people. He was always getting CDs. And we’d listen to it and talk about it and analyze, and he’d be talking about you know when he went to the Pacific, you know in college when he was a young man. And he’s going, “I could play like Art Tatum, man, I had that accident.…

Did you ever hear that bit about, this was near the beginning of when his career was taking off and critics were saying he can’t swing. And there’s a thing in DownBeat where he says, “Any jackass can swing.” That’s probably the nastiest word he ever said.
